主要内容: CHS Inc. (NASDAQ: CHSCP) reported fiscal 2014 earnings of $1.1 billion, the second highest in its history, up 9% from $992.4 million in fiscal 2013. Revenues declined to $42.7 billion from $44.5 billion in fiscal 2013, primarily due to lower commodity values. CHS Energy segment earnings declined due to lower refining margins, while CHS Ag segment earnings increased due to logistics and risk management capabilities. CHS Country Operations achieved record earnings from local retail, animal nutrition, and sunflower businesses. CHS Processing and Food Ingredients earnings declined due to non-cash asset impairment charges. CHS also reported a $109.2 million gain from the formation of Ardent Mills in May 2014. The company returned a record $637.2 million to owners through cash patronage, equity redemptions, and dividends on preferred stock, including a one-time retirement of $200 million in qualified owner equity with preferred stock.
